audit.verdict: 没有任何 VASP 层可以检查。曲线与热力学量都能读出来，但"它们是怎么算出来的"在这个端基里无法验证，所以状态是 unverifiable 而不是 pass。不得把它当作已验证数据。详见 FINDINGS.md。

evidence: phonons/thermal_properties-0N.yaml: natom: 2 (so the cell has two atoms, but the yaml does not name them)
the volume range 33.16-37.23 A^3 for a 2-atom cell is 16.6-18.6 A^3/atom, the range a bcc Ti-Nb alloy occupies

ht-vasp's independently relaxed BCC-Nb-Ti cell (structure/from-ht-vasp/POSCAR-unitcell, a = 3.266876449678747 A, V = 34.865689687333266 A^3) falls inside the legacy volume range, 0.127 % above the legacy discrete minimum volume 34.91 A^3
composition_reduced.not_proven_by: no file in this endpoint names an element. The directory label is not evidence (§B.5.8). If the composition matters for a downstream step, it must come from a profile or an explicit user decision.
composition_reduced.warning: ht-vasp also carries an independent modern (atomate2) QHA calculation for the same nominal endpoint. It is NOT the same calculation: its Gibbs curve starts at -17.83702657957205 eV/f.u. against this endpoint's -17.679267504318961 eV/f.u., 0.158 eV/f.u. apart. Do not mix the two, and do not use one to fill in the other's missing metadata.

structure_prototype.note: no structure file exists in this endpoint. Only natom: 2 is known from the thermal-property yaml.

anchor_cell.note: the volume grid's anchor is not recoverable: see volume_grid below. An outside cell (e.g. the ht-vasp relaxed one) can be offered as a working hypothesis, but it would be an import, not a property of this endpoint.

evidence: the volumes themselves are read directly from curves/v-e.dat
uniformity in volume is exact (the seven spacings are 0.58/0.58/0.59/0.58/0.58/0.58/0.58 A^3); uniformity in lattice constant is not (a_i spacings drift from 0.01862 to 0.01743 A)
volume_grid.unknown: the generating law and its anchor volume cannot be recovered. If it were the same family as BCC-Co-Ti-2 (V/V0 = linspace(s0, s1, N)) then s0 ~ 0.950 and s1 ~ 1.0666 with V0 ~ 34.905 A^3, but 34.905 matches neither the BM3 equilibrium volume (34.779724 A^3) nor the ht-vasp relaxed volume (34.865690 A^3), so this reconstruction is not supported. The per-volume cells are simply absent.

calculation_method.note: no OUTCAR, no INCAR, no FORCE_CONSTANTS, no mesh.yaml: nothing distinguishes DFPT from finite displacements here. Per em-tdb-v2 plan v2 §B.5.6 item 9 the method must stay unknown unless independent provenance evidence exists — a .dat file and a phonopy-style yaml are not that evidence.

eos_fit_bm3.caution: 8 points and 4 free parameters: R^2 prints as 1.0 at double precision and the largest residual is 0.024 meV. The fit is not independent evidence of anything; it is a summary of 8 numbers.

gibbs_curve.reading: one 2.29 eV/cell discontinuity at 2650->2660 K. That is ~13 % of the whole 0-2960 K drop happening in one 10 K step. Combined with the imaginary modes at 6/8 volumes the high-temperature part of this curve is not trustworthy.
